Tests page extraction and page marker configuration

```python title="Python"
import asyncio
from xberg import extract, ExtractInput, ExtractionConfig, PageConfig, ExtractInputKind

async def main() -> None:
    input = ExtractInput(kind=ExtractInputKind("uri"), uri="https://example.com/pdf/fake_memo.pdf")
    config = ExtractionConfig(pages=PageConfig(extract_pages=True, insert_page_markers=True))
    result = await extract(input, config)
    print(result.results[0].mime_type)
    print(result.results[0].content)

asyncio.run(main())
```
